Coffee Brewing Tips

Achieving the perfect cup of coffee is both an art and a science. Here are two essential tips to elevate your daily brew:

  • Master the Ratio: Use a consistent water-to-coffee ratio. A standard starting point is the "Golden Ratio" of 1:15 to 1:18 (1 gram of coffee for every 15 to 18 grams of water), which you can easily adjust to match your strength preference.

  • Match Your Grind to Your Method: The size of your coffee grounds dictates how quickly water extracts flavor. Use a coarse grind for immersion methods like a French Press, and a medium-to-fine grind for drip or pour-over setups to avoid over- or under-extraction.
